# Casa del Jaguar

> All-inclusive ayahuasca retreat in the city of Iquitos, Peru. 7 days and 6 nights, from $2,800 USD.

Casa del Jaguar is an ancestral-medicine retreat in an urban area of Iquitos, Loreto, Peru, not a remote jungle lodge. Ceremonies take place in the centre's maloca. The centre picks guests up at Coronel FAP Francisco Secada Vignetta Airport (IQT). The public pages describe the trip from the airport as a few minutes. Guided Amazon excursions run on integration days.

## Main offer

- Duration: 7 days and 6 nights
- Price shown on the pricing page: from $2,800 USD. Room category can change the final price.
- Includes: private accommodation, meals, 4 ayahuasca ceremonies guided by Maestro Denis Montes, complementary activities, airport transfer, post-retreat follow-up, and 2 guided Amazon excursions
- Also described in the FAQ: rapé ceremony, flower baths, integration sessions, and individual sessions
- Phone and WhatsApp: +51 917 811 803
- Email: info@casadeljaguariquitos.com
- Website: https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/
- English: https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/
- Preferred dates can be requested. The team confirms availability. The calendar is not a live inventory.

## Who guides the work

Maestro Denis Montes was born in Iquitos in 1983. He is a chemical engineer and a member of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP 271557). His first encounter with ayahuasca was at age 16, while working as an official tour guide. His shamanic training began in 2012 under Maestro Dan Reynolds.

## Safety, as stated on the site

- Adults over 18, with a medical and psychological questionnaire before the retreat
- The FAQ says ceremonies are led by Denis Montes, with medical staff present and a prior health evaluation
- Antidepressants, anxiolytics, other psychotropics, St. John's wort, 5-HTP, and tramadol are named as medicines to stop only with the guest's own doctor, generally 4 to 6 weeks before
- The terms say Casa del Jaguar does not provide medical insurance

## Location

City of Iquitos, Loreto, Peru. Urban area, minutes from the airport. Ceremonies are in the maloca at the centre. The contact page says the exact street address is shared when a booking is confirmed.
